values.note: 2026: water + 30-amp $46 a night spring/fall, $50 summer; water + 50-amp $49 / $53; primitive sites (no hookups) $41. Base covers one camping unit, up to 5 people and 2 vehicles; extra tent $10; dump station free at departure, $10 on arrival.

season.source: https://campottercreek.com/make-reservation/ ('OPEN for the 2026 season: April 15th until November 1st') + https://campottercreek.com/ ('The campground is open mid April – October'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservation inquiry form on the website (it does not book; staff reply within about 48 hours to finalize) or phone 717-862-3628. One-night deposit; holiday weekends 3-night minimum, paid in full in advance. 7 days' notice for a refund less $10. 2027 reservations accepted after January 1.

booking.source: https://campottercreek.com/make-reservation/ ('Please note that this step does not book your stay. Upon completion, you will be contacted ... to finalize your requested reservation', 'Holiday weekends require 3 night-minimum and full payment in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the 2026 $46-53 rates (base water+30A), 30/50-amp with water, 89 sites, seasonal, reservable by request. Added season dates (Apr 15 - Nov 1, 2026), showers/laundry/drinking water/dump/store, holiday 3-night minimum, deposit/cancellation terms.
